content_zh: 点名娶她司绵躲在门口，听不太清楚里面说些什么，但是见大家都没注意到她，她也没兴趣进去掺合，准备等一下就溜走。苏建豪不停的为两人牵线搭桥，但是却觉得顾墨有点无动于衷，心里暗暗着急。这个时候，一穿职业装的女子朝休息室走过来，司绵赶紧往旁边闪，那女子敲了门，然后进去，走到那个男子的身边说了两句话。顾墨掀起眼眸，朝着苏建豪说，“苏伯父，失陪一下，我有点急事需要处理”“顾总裁，您忙，不用管我们”苏建豪立刻起身相送。见里面的人要出来了，司绵溜了。…..办公室里，顾墨正在跟人交谈些什么，突然，他眉头一皱，透过玻璃望出去，一娇小的女孩正在外面不远处鬼鬼祟祟的走着。一看就不是工作人员，形迹十分可疑。顾墨脸上有不悦的神情，“这里成了菜市场吗？谁都可以进来？”助理立刻打电话给特警人员，然后准备去拦截。顾墨以为等一下她就会被特警人员给抓走，但是却看见他们准备靠近时候，助理挥手让那些特警人员停住，然后她小跑的过去，脸上有着微笑，跟她说了几句话，然后她点点头便往另一个方向走去。但是当那个女孩微微抬起头的时候，那侧脸竟然让他觉得是那么的熟悉，顾墨眯起眼睛，她怎么会出现在这里？她不可能是这里的工作人员，不然那天她不会不知道他顾墨是谁。助理回来，连忙解释，“那个小女孩是跟苏家人一起来的，是老爷子的客人”老爸带来的？顾墨挑眉，老爸挑媳妇的要求，他还是知道的，不说一定要大家闺秀，怎么也要小家碧玉，这个女孩，一看就是会惹事的主，爸肯定不会把她纳入人选。顾墨不着痕迹的敛下眼眸，“把这个文件发下去，我先去招呼客人了”虽然很不想回去面对苏家的人，但是怎么说也是老爸带来的，所以这点面子顾墨还是要给。处理完事情，他就回去，苏建豪自然是乐不可支的。顾墨扫视了一圈，也没见那抹鬼鬼祟祟的身影，“顾伯父，我记得你今天好像带了两个女儿来吧，怎么就只看见苏二小姐呢？”这个时候苏建豪跟刘紫兰才发现司绵不在这里，苏建豪责备的看了刘紫兰一眼，随即顿了顿说，“绵绵她去洗手间了，等一下就回来”“既然她不在，那么我就先跟你们说一声，我要娶她”顾墨漫不经心的甩下重磅炸弹。所有的人都不敢置信的看着顾墨，心里都有同一个疑问，他是开玩笑的吗？但是顾墨却没有要回答的意思，坐在那儿，即使不说话，气场也是很强大的。刘紫兰更是心跳加速，赶紧出去寻人。好不容易找到了，刘紫兰对着司绵左看右看，不是她看不起自己的女儿，实在是司绵跟心心比起来，确实有点差距。绵绵是什么样的性子，做妈的清楚的很，野起来跟假小子一样，不过随她嫁来苏家之后，她明显收敛了很多。这样的她，实在不足以胜任总裁夫人啊。司绵纳闷不已，“妈，你怎么了，难不成连你女儿都不认识了”“绵绵啊，也不知道是福还是祸，不过先告诉你一声，让你有心理准备，总裁要娶你”刘紫兰摸摸她的脸颊，当妈的是半是忧愁，半是喜啊。“啊——”司绵错愕，这什么跟什么，总裁要娶她？她什么时候有名到，连总裁都对她仰慕了。推开休息室的门，司绵就鼓起勇气吼出，“我不嫁”
content_en: Si Mian hid at the door and couldn't hear clearly what was said, but seeing that no one noticed her, she had no interest in joining in and planned to sneak away later. Su Jianhao kept trying to connect the two, but he felt that Gu Mo was a little indifferent and secretly worried. At this time, a woman in professional attire walked towards the lounge. Si Mian quickly stepped aside. The woman knocked on the door, then went in, walked up to the man and said a few words. Gu Mo raised his eyes and said to Su Jianhao, "Uncle Su, please excuse me, I have something urgent to deal with." "President Gu, you are busy, don't worry about us." Su Jianhao immediately stood up to see him off. Seeing that the people inside were about to come out, Si Mian slipped away. ..... In the office, Gu Mo was talking to someone. Suddenly, he frowned and looked out through the glass. A petite girl was sneaking around not far away. At first glance, it seemed that he was not a staff member, and his behavior was very suspicious. Gu Mo had an unhappy look on his face, "Is this a vegetable market? Anyone can come in?" The assistant immediately called the special police officers and prepared to intercept. Gu Mo thought that she would be arrested by the SWAT officers after a while, but when they were about to approach, the assistant waved the SWAT officers to stop. Then she ran over with a smile on her face and said a few words to her. Then she nodded and walked in the other direction. But when the girl raised her head slightly, the profile of her face felt so familiar to him. Gu Mo narrowed his eyes, why was she here? She couldn't be a staff member here, otherwise she wouldn't have known who Gu Mo was that day. The assistant came back and quickly explained, "That little girl came with the Su family and is the old man's guest." Did dad bring her? Gu Mo raised his eyebrows. He still knew his father's requirements for choosing a wife. Not only did he want everyone to be a lady, but he also wanted Xiaojiabiyu. This girl looked like a troublemaker, and his father would definitely not include her in the selection. Gu Mo lowered his eyes without leaving a trace, "Send this document, I'm going to greet the guests first." Although he didn't want to go back and face the people of the Su family, after all, it was his father who brought it, so Gu Mo still had to give him this face. After handling the matter, he went back. Su Jianhao was naturally overjoyed. Gu Mo glanced around and saw no sneaky figure, "Uncle Gu, I remember you brought two daughters here today. Why did you only see Miss Su Er?" At this time, Su Jianhao and Liu Zilan realized that Si Mian was not here. , Su Jianhao glanced at Liu Zilan reproachfully, then paused and said, "Mianmian went to the bathroom and will be back later." "Since she's not here, I'll tell you first that I want to marry her." Gu Mo casually dropped the bombshell. Everyone looked at Gu Mo in disbelief and all had the same question in their hearts, was he kidding? But Gu Mo had no intention of answering. Sitting there, even if he didn't speak, his aura was very strong. Liu Zilan's heartbeat accelerated and she hurried out to look for someone. After finally finding it, Liu Zilan looked left and right at Si Mian. It wasn't that she looked down on her daughter, but it was because there was indeed a gap between Si Mian and Xin Xin. As a mother, she knew very well what kind of temper Mianmian was like. When she was wild, she was like a tomboy. However, after she married into the Su family, she obviously restrained herself a lot. She is really not qualified to be the CEO's wife. Si Mian was puzzled, "Mom, what's wrong with you? Is it possible that you don't even recognize your daughter?" "Mianmian, I don't know if it's a blessing or a curse, but I'll tell you first so that you can be mentally prepared. The president wants to marry you." Liu Zilan touched her cheek. The mother felt half sad and half happy. "Ah -" Si Mian was stunned, what is this, the CEO wants to marry her? When did she become so famous that even the CEO admired her. Pushing open the door to the lounge, Si Mian mustered up the courage to shout, "I won't get married."
novel_title: 先婚后爱,大叔,我才成年
